verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ነገር ፡ ኮነ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ አብራም ፡ በራእይ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ኢትፍራህ ፡ አብራም
                  ፡ አነ ፡ ኣጸንዐከ ፡ ወዐስብከ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በኀቤየ ።
verses.translation: And after these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram, I shield thee, thy reward shall be very great.

translations.lxx: And after these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram, I shield thee, thy reward shall be very great.
translations.kjv: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
translations.ron: După acestea, fost-a cuvântul Domnului către Avram, noaptea, în vis, şi a zis: "Nu te teme, Avrame, că Eu sunt scutul tău şi răsplata ta va fi foarte mare!"

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ አብራም ፡ ምንት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ዘትሁበኒ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ እመውት ፡ እንዘ ፡ አልብየ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ወናሁ ፡
                  ወልደ ፡ ማሴቅ ፡ ዘደማስቆ ፡ ዘይብልዎ ፡ ኢያውብር ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ ትውልደ ፡ ዘመድየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይወርሰኒ ።
verses.translation: And Abram said, Master and Lord, what wilt thou give me? whereas I am departing without a child, but the son of Masek my home-born female slave, this Eliezer of Damascus is mine heir.

translations.lxx: And Abram said, Master and Lord, what wilt thou give me? whereas I am departing without a child, but the son of Masek my home-born female slave, this Eliezer of Damascus is mine heir.
translations.kjv: And Abram said, LORD God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
translations.ron: Iar Avram a răspuns: "Stăpâne Doamne, ce ai să-mi dai? Că iată eu am să mor fără copii şi cârmuitor în casa mea este Eliezer din Damasc".

verses.geez: ይቤ ፡ አብራም ፡ እስመ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ኢወሀብከኒ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ትውልደ ፡ ዘመድየ ፡ ይወርሰኒ ።
verses.translation: And Abram said, I am grieved since thou hast given me no seed, but my home-born servant shall succeed me.

translations.lxx: And Abram said, I am grieved since thou hast given me no seed, but my home-born servant shall succeed me.
translations.kjv: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
translations.ron: Apoi Avram a adăugat: "De vreme ce nu mi-ai dat fii, iată sluga mea va fi moştenitor după mine!"

verses.geez:
ወበጊዜሃ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ኢይወርሴከ ፡ ውእቱሰ ፡ ካልእ ፡ ይወጽእ ፡ እምኔከ ፡
                  ወውእቱ ፡ ይወርሰከ ።
verses.translation: And immediately there was a voice of the Lord to him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come out of thee shall be thine heir.

translations.lxx: And immediately there was a voice of the Lord to him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come out of thee shall be thine heir.
translations.kjv: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
translations.ron: Şi îndată s-a făcut cuvântul Domnului către el şi a zis: "Nu te va moşteni acela, ci cel ce va răsări din coapsele tale, acela te va moşteni!"

verses.geez:
ወአውጽኦ ፡ አፍአ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ወኈልቆሙ ፡ ለከዋክብት ፡ ለእመ ፡ ትክል ፡ ኈልቆቶሙ
                  ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘርእከ ።
verses.translation: And he brought him out and said to him, Look up now to heaven, and count the stars, if thou shalt be able to number them fully, and he said, Thus shall thy seed be.

translations.lxx: And he brought him out and said to him, Look up now to heaven, and count the stars, if thou shalt be able to number them fully, and he said, Thus shall thy seed be.
translations.kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
translations.ron: Apoi l-a scos afară şi i-a zis: "Priveşte la cer şi numără stelele, de le poţi număra!" Şi a adăugat: "Atât de mulţi vor fi urmaşii tăi!"

verses.geez: ወአምኖ ፡ አብራም ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተኈለቆ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ጽድቀ ።
verses.translation: And Abram believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.

translations.lxx: And Abram believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.
translations.kjv: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
translations.ron: Şi a crezut Avram pe Domnul şi i s-a socotit aceasta ca dreptate.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ዘአውጻእኩከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከላዴዎን ፡ ከመ ፡ አሀብካሃ ፡
                  ለይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ትትዋረሳ ።
verses.translation: And he said to him, I am God that brought thee out of the land of the Chaldeans, so as to give thee this land to inherit.

translations.lxx: And he said to him, I am God that brought thee out of the land of the Chaldeans, so as to give thee this land to inherit.
translations.kjv: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
translations.ron: Şi i-a zis iarăşi: "Eu sunt Domnul, Care te-a scos din Urul Caldeii, ca să-ţi dau pământul acesta de moştenire".

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ [እግዚኦ ፡ በምንት ፡ ኣአምር ፡ ከመ ፡ እወርሳ ።
verses.translation: And he said, Master and Lord, how shall I know that I shall inherit it?

translations.lxx: And he said, Master and Lord, how shall I know that I shall inherit it?
translations.kjv: And he said, LORD God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
translations.ron: Şi a zis Avram: "Stăpâne Doamne pe ce voi cunoaşte că-l voi moşteni?"

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡] ንሣእ ፡ ለከ ፡ ለህመ ፡ ዘሠለስቱ ፡ ዓመቱ ፡ ወጠሌ ፡ ዘሠለስቱ ፡ ዓመቱ ፡ ወበግዐ ፡ ዘ፫ዓመቱ ፡ ወማዕነቀ
                  ፡ ወርግበ ።
verses.translation: And he said to him, Take for me an heifer in her third year, and a she-goat in her third year, and a ram in his third year, and a dove and a pigeon.

translations.lxx: And he said to him, Take for me an heifer in her third year, and a she-goat in her third year, and a ram in his third year, and a dove and a pigeon.
translations.kjv: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
translations.ron: Iar Domnul i-a zis: "Găteşte-Mi o junincă de trei ani, o capră de trei ani, un berbec de trei ani, o turturică şi un pui de porumbel!"

verses.geez: ወንሣእ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ወምትሮሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ወለአዕዋፍሰ ፡ ኢትምትሮን ።
verses.translation: So he took to him all these, and divided them in the midst, and set them opposite to each other, but the birds he did not divide.

translations.lxx: So he took to him all these, and divided them in the midst, and set them opposite to each other, but the birds he did not divide.
translations.kjv: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
translations.ron: Şi a luat Avram toate aceste animale, le-a tăiat în două şi a pus bucăţile una în faţa alteia; iar păsările nu le-a tăiat.

verses.geez: ወወረዱ ፡ እልክቱ ፡ አዕዋፍ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ዘመዶሙ ፡ ዘተመትሩ ፡ ወነበረ ፡ አብራም ፡ ኀቤሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And birds came down upon the bodies, even upon the divided parts of them, and Abram sat down by them.

translations.lxx: And birds came down upon the bodies, even upon the divided parts of them, and Abram sat down by them.
translations.kjv: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
translations.ron: Şi năvăleau păsările răpitoare asupra trupurilor, iar Avram le alunga.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ የዐርብ ፡ ፀሓይ ፡ ድንጋፄ ፡ መጽኦ ፡ ለአብራም ፡ ወናሁ ፡ ግሩም ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ወዐቢይ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And about sunset a trance fell upon Abram, and lo! a great gloomy terror falls upon him.

translations.lxx: And about sunset a trance fell upon Abram, and lo! a great gloomy terror falls upon him.
translations.kjv: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
translations.ron: La asfinţitul soarelui, a căzut peste Avram somn greu şi iată l-a cuprins întuneric şi frică mare.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለአብራም ፡ አእምሮ ፡ አእምር ፡ ከመ ፡ ሀለዎ ፡ ለዘርእከ ፡ ፈላሴ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡
                  ኢኮነት ፡ እንቲአአሆሙ ፡ ወይቀንይዎሙ ፡ ወይሣቅይዎሙ ፡ ወያጼዕርዎሙ ፡ አርባዕተ ፡ ምእታ ፡ ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And it was said to Abram, Thou shalt surely know that thy seed shall be a sojourner in a land not their own, and they shall enslave them, and afflict them, and humble them four hundred years.

translations.lxx: And it was said to Abram, Thou shalt surely know that thy seed shall be a sojourner in a land not their own, and they shall enslave them, and afflict them, and humble them four hundred years.
translations.kjv: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Domnul către Avram: "Să ştii bine că urmaşii tăi vor pribegi în pământ străin, unde vor fi robiţi şi apăsaţi patru sute de ani;

verses.geez:
ወለውእቱሰ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሣቅይዎሙ ፡ አነ ፡ እኴንኖሙ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይወጽኡ ፡ ዝየ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ብዙኅ
                  ፡ ንዋይ ።
verses.translation: And the nation whomsoever they shall serve I will judge; and after this, they shall come forth hither with much property.

translations.lxx: And the nation whomsoever they shall serve I will judge; and after this, they shall come forth hither with much property.
translations.kjv: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
translations.ron: Dar pe neamul acela, căruia ei vor fi robi, îl voi judeca Eu şi după aceea ei vor ieşi să vină aici, cu avere multă.

verses.geez: ወአንተሰ ፡ ተሐውር ፡ ወትገብእ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አበዊከ ፡ በርሥእ ፡ ሠናይ ።
verses.translation: But thou shalt depart to thy fathers in peace, nourished in a good old age.

translations.lxx: But thou shalt depart to thy fathers in peace, nourished in a good old age.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
translations.ron: Iar tu vei trece la părinţii tăi în pace şi vei fi îngropat la bătrâneţi fericite.

verses.geez: ወበራብዕ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ይገብኡ ፡ ዝየ ፡ እስመ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ ኢተፈጸመ ፡ ኀጣውኢሆሙ ፡ ለአሞሬዎን ።
verses.translation: And in the fourth generation they shall return hither, for the sins of the Amorites are not yet filled up, even until now.

translations.lxx: And in the fourth generation they shall return hither, for the sins of the Amorites are not yet filled up, even until now.
translations.kjv: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
translations.ron: Ei însă se vor întoarce aici, în al patrulea veac de oameni, căci nu s-a umplut încă măsura nelegiuirilor Amoreilor".

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ይዕረብ ፡ ፀሓይ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ነድ ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ እሳት ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ እቶን ፡ ዘይጠይስ ፡ ኀለፈ ፡
                  እንት ፡ ማእከሉ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ዘመተረ ።
verses.translation: And when the sun was about to set, there was a flame, and behold a smoking furnace and lamps of fire, which passed between these divided pieces.

translations.lxx: And when the sun was about to set, there was a flame, and behold a smoking furnace and lamps of fire, which passed between these divided pieces.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a asfinţit soarele şi s-a făcut întuneric, iată un fum ca dintr-un cuptor şi pară de foc au trecut printre bucăţile acelea.

verses.geez:
ወበይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ አቅመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአብራም ፡ ዘአሰፈዎ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ለዘርእከ ፡ እሁባ ፡ ለዛቲ ፡ ምድር ፡
                  እምነ ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እስከ ፡ ፈለግ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ኤፍራጦስ ፤
verses.translation: In that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, To thy seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river Euphrates.

translations.lxx: In that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, To thy seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river Euphrates.
translations.kjv: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
translations.ron: ÃŽn ziua aceea a încheiat Domnul legământ cu Avram, zicând: "Urmaşilor tăi voi da pământul acesta de la râul Egiptului până la râul cel mare al Eufratului;

verses.geez: ዘቄኖስ ፡ ወዘቄኔዜዎስ ፡ ወዘቄሜኔሎስ ፤
verses.translation: The Kenites, and the Kenezites, and the Kedmoneans,

translations.lxx: The Kenites, and the Kenezites, and the Kedmoneans,
translations.kjv: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
translations.ron: Voi da pe Chenei, pe Chenezei, pe Chedmonei,

verses.geez: ወዘቄጥዮስ ፡ ወዘፌሬዜዎስ ፡ ወዘፈራዮን ፤
verses.translation: and the Chettites, and the Pherezites, and the Raphaim,

translations.lxx: and the Chettites, and the Pherezites, and the Raphaim,
translations.kjv: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
translations.ron: Pe Hetei, pe Ferezei, pe Refaimi,

verses.geez: ወዘአሞሬዎስ ፡ ወዘከናኔዎን ፡ ወዘጌርጌሴዎስ ፡ ወ[ዘኢያቡሴ]ዎስ ።
verses.translation: and the Amorites, and the Chananites, and the Evites, and the Gergesites, and the Jebusites.

translations.lxx: and the Amorites, and the Chananites, and the Evites, and the Gergesites, and the Jebusites.
translations.kjv: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
translations.ron: Pe Amorei, pe Canaanei, pe Hevei, pe Gherghesei şi pe Iebusei".
